semanticAction.title: Create a Proven Products collection led by Borderlands Discovery Four
semanticAction.whyNow: The store has recorded only 6 active selling days in the trailing 30 days and has a compact 17-product range. A reversible placement can focus attention on the proven lead product while avoiding inventory or pricing risk.
semanticAction.outcome: Give the store's proven revenue leader a dedicated, easy-to-find merchandising destination that can be linked from the storefront or other sales materials.
semanticAction.summary: Create a dedicated merchandising collection and place Borderlands Discovery Four first as the lead proven product. Shopify confirms the product is active, available for sale, stocked with 61 units, and not currently featured in the existing Bundles collection.
constraints: Do not change product status, pricing, inventory, descriptions, or existing collection membership.
Do not remove products from any existing collection.
Use a new dedicated collection rather than altering the existing Bundles collection.
The recommendation is based on revenue evidence; product cost and margin are unavailable because all 25 active variants have no unit cost recorded.
semanticAction.whyThisAction: Borderlands Discovery Four generated £444 and 22.96% of trailing-90-day product revenue, making it the clearest lead product for a focused merchandising placement. The live Shopify read confirms it is ACTIVE, available for sale, and has 61 units in stock.
semanticAction.expectedBenefit: A new dedicated collection is created for proven products.; Borderlands Discovery Four is added to that collection as the lead product.; No existing product, inventory, price, or collection is modified or removed.
semanticAction.verificationPlan: After acceptance, verify that the new collection exists, contains Borderlands Discovery Four, preserves the product's ACTIVE status and current inventory, and does not alter existing collections. Measure subsequent collection-attributed or product-level revenue against the current trailing-period baseline.
materialExpectedEffects: A new dedicated collection is created for proven products.
Borderlands Discovery Four is added to that collection as the lead product.
No existing product, inventory, price, or collection is modified or removed.

candidateQueue.reason: The required live Shopify read did not return a successful result, so I cannot verify that Borderlands Discovery Four and Cloud Needle Tsolikouri currently exist, are active, are available for sale, or are not already covered by an existing collection. No mutation was performed.
candidateQueue.operationQuery: Create or improve a prominently merchandised collection featuring proven products, led by Borderlands Discovery Four and Cloud Needle Tsolikouri. Recent sales are intermittent: 13 orders occurred on only 6 of the last 30 days, with 0 orders in the last 7 days and 19 days since the latest stored order.
candidateQueue.diagnosedProblem: Recent sales are intermittent: 13 orders occurred on only 6 of the last 30 days, with 0 orders in the last 7 days and 19 days since the latest stored order.

candidateQueue.reason: Shopify state confirms the premise: all 25 active variants have prices but every queried inventoryItem.unitCost is null. However, the proposed write requires actual cost-per-item values, and no cost data or trustworthy mapping from product attributes to costs is available in Shopify. Writing guessed or price-derived costs would create misleading margin data. The safe Shopify write path would be inventory-item cost updates only after the merchant supplies or confirms the costs.
candidateQueue.operationQuery: Populate cost-per-item for the active variants, beginning with the highest-revenue and highest-stock-value variants. All 25 active variants have prices but none has a recorded cost per item, so product-level gross margin cannot be evaluated from the catalogue.
candidateQueue.diagnosedProblem: All 25 active variants have prices but none has a recorded cost per item, so product-level gross margin cannot be evaluated from the catalogue.

candidateQueue.operationQuery: Feature the top-selling products in a dedicated collection or storefront merchandising placement, with Borderlands Discovery Four as the lead product. Demand is concentrated in a small subset of the range: the top five products generate 61.17% of product revenue, while 13 products declined versus the prior 30-day period and only one rose.
candidateQueue.diagnosedProblem: Demand is concentrated in a small subset of the range: the top five products generate 61.17% of product revenue, while 13 products declined versus the prior 30-day period and only one rose.

candidateQueue.operationQuery: Create curated product bundles or complementary-product merchandising around the best-selling wine products. Most orders are small: 54% contain exactly one item, the median order contains one item, and only 6% contain four or more items.
candidateQueue.diagnosedProblem: Most orders are small: 54% contain exactly one item, the median order contains one item, and only 6% contain four or more items.

candidateQueue.operationQuery: Improve customer account or email capture at checkout and associate future orders with customer records. None of the 50 stored orders is linked to a known customer identity, so repeat purchasing cannot be measured or used for customer-level revenue activity.
candidateQueue.diagnosedProblem: None of the 50 stored orders is linked to a known customer identity, so repeat purchasing cannot be measured or used for customer-level revenue activity.

candidateQueue.operationQuery: Feature the unsold product in a relevant collection or pair it with a proven product in a curated offer. One active product has inventory but no recorded sales in the trailing 90 days, leaving part of the active range without demonstrated demand.
candidateQueue.diagnosedProblem: One active product has inventory but no recorded sales in the trailing 90 days, leaving part of the active range without demonstrated demand.

candidateQueue.operationQuery: Refresh or reconcile inventory quantities for all active variants, prioritising the highest-value stocked variants. All 51 recorded inventory levels are older than the 72-hour freshness threshold, so current stock availability signals are stale even though inventory coverage exists for all 25 tracked variants.
candidateQueue.diagnosedProblem: All 51 recorded inventory levels are older than the 72-hour freshness threshold, so current stock availability signals are stale even though inventory coverage exists for all 25 tracked variants.

hypothesesConsidered.reason: Shopify confirms Borderlands Discovery Four is ACTIVE, has 61 units of inventory, is available for sale, and is not currently in the existing Bundles collection. Merchant evidence identifies it as the trailing-90-day revenue leader at £444 and 22.96% of product revenue.
hypothesesConsidered.hypothesis: Featuring currently active, in-stock products with demonstrated demand in a dedicated collection can focus customer attention on likely revenue generators.
